concerns.text: Task T002 allows a fallback to the NF‑BoT‑IoT‑v3 dataset if the CTU‑13 download fails. This weakens FR‑001, which *mandates* ingestion of the CTU‑13 dataset. Introducing an alternative dataset without explicit spec amendment violates the mandatory functional requirement.

SC‑002 requires measuring the GCN’s AUC‑ROC *against* the Random Forest baseline to assess added predictive value. T007 only records per‑model AUC‑ROC values and does not perform an explicit comparative check or pass/fail criterion, thereby dropping an acceptance criterion from the specification.
